content.text:
The site looked different because the web font wasn't loading. In `site/css/tokens.css`, the `@font-face` pointed at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the directory is `site/fonts/`. The request 404'd and every page fell back to the system font, which changes the text width and weight across the site.

I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. No other `url()`, stylesheet, script or asset references are broken, and all 16 functional tests pass.

The repo has a single commit, so I couldn't confirm which change introduced the typo. I also haven't looked at the pages in a browser. The functional tests don't check fonts, so the passing run doesn't confirm the fix.

I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
